items.q: And so Lee Deere told me, he says, 'Look, I can take you up to play piano for some friends of mine

ctx.x: And so Lee Deere told me, he says, 'Look, I can take you up to play piano for some friends of mine, but Art Bronson is playing at my club, but see, I'd like to have you with these guys here. But Art's playing at my club. But if you go,' he says, 'I'll guarantee you $14 a week and you'll make good tips.' I said, 'Oh,' I didn't believe it, you know. He says, 'Yes, I'll guarantee it, yes.' So then I got to thinking. I said, Well, I think I'll take this,' you know?
Well, listen, Jay, I'm a little muddled. Art Bronson was playing with the group he came to take?
